observations: Multiple stacks of used car tires in an outdoor or semi-covered storage area.
Tires are stacked high, suggesting a bulk inventory.
Tread depth varies across the stacks, indicating different ages and usage.
Some tires have handwritten markings on the sidewall, such as 'R225' and '50'.
Watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible across all photos.
No brand names or model numbers are legible on the visible sidewalls.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired or past their service life.
risks.proof: A photo of the DOT (Department of Transportation) code on the sidewall showing the manufacturing date.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be insufficient for legal or safe use.
risks.proof: A photo of the tread depth gauge or a close-up of the tread pattern.
risks.if_unproven: as having very low tread depth

risks.risk: Tires may be damaged internally (blown or cracked),
risks.proof: A video showing a professional internal inspection or a photo of the tire's internal structure.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the sidewall of any tire showing the brand name and model number.
Photo of the DOT code on the sidewall to verify manufacturing date and expiration.
Photo of the tread depth gauge or a close-up of the tread pattern.
Video of a professional tire inspection.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
